messages.author: 5900eadecec2d82d
messages.subject: Re: zigzag sampler error
parts:
Didn't get to the bottom of it last time. Sounds like you do have a
program bug. Adjusted angle zigzag is rarely (ever?) used in practice,
as pilots/captains don't like to fly/sail curved lines (or even straight
line segments as approximations). So probably little tested. If you
send me your project file (Export to zip as usual) and tell me how to
recreate the problem, I'll check it out. Cheers,

- Len Thomas
